name: TI LP5024 24-channel I2C RGB LED driver (VQFN-32)
description: Texas Instruments LP5024 24-channel constant-current-sink RGB LED driver in the 32-pin 4 x 4 mm VQFN (RSM): VCC 2.7-5.5 V, 24 outputs up to 25.5 mA each (35 mA with VCC >= 3.3 V) set by one IREF resistor, 12-bit 29 kHz PWM per channel with 8-bit colour per output and 8-bit brightness per RGB group, three colour banks, I2C target up to 400 kHz at 0x28-0x2B (two address pins) plus broadcast 0x3C, 0.2 uA shutdown with EN low and 6 uA automatic power-save.

ADDR0 — I2C slave-address selection pin. This pin must not be left floating.

params.note: Tie ADDR0 to GND or VCC (Table 7-2). Absolute maximum -0.3 V to VCC + 0.3 V, so it must not be pulled above the LP5024's own VCC.

params.description: ADDR1 — I2C slave-address selection pin. This pin must not be left floating.

params.note: Tie ADDR1 to GND or VCC (Table 7-2). Absolute maximum -0.3 V to VCC + 0.3 V, so it must not be pulled above the LP5024's own VCC.

params.description: VCC (I) — Input power.
SDA (I/O) — I2C bus data line. If not used, this pin must be connected to GND or VCC.
SCL (I) — I2C bus clock line. If not used, this pin must be connected to GND or VCC.
EN (I) — Chip enable input pin

params.note: EN low = SHUTDOWN (0.2 uA typ, 1 uA max); EN high = INITIALIZATION (registers reset) then STANDBY until Chip_EN (DEVICE_CONFIG0 bit 6) is written 1. Wait tEN_H (500 us max) after the first EN rising edge before the first I2C access. VIH >= 1.4 V, VIL <= 0.4 V, -0.3 to 6 V absolute maximum.

params.description: IREF — Output current-reference global-setting pin

params.note: Connect RIREF from IREF to GND: RIREF = KIREF x VIREF / ISET, KIREF = 105, VIREF = 0.7 V (e.g. ISET 15 mA -> 4.9 kOhm; 5 mA -> 14.7 kOhm). ISET is the full-scale current of all 24 outputs. IREF floating gives near-zero output current; IREF shorted to GND gives the internal limit ILIM (35-80 mA, or 40-120 mA with Max_Current_Option = 1), so the resistor is required. Place RIREF close to the device.

params.description: VCAP — Internal LDO output pin, this pin must be connected to a 1µF capacitor to GND. Place the capacitor as close to the device as possible.

params.note: 1 uF from VCAP to GND, as close to the device as possible. VCAP absolute maximum -0.3 to 2 V; do not load it.

params.description: GND — Exposed thermal pad also serves the ground pin for the device.

params.note: The thermal pad must be soldered to the board for thermal and mechanical performance; add as many thermal vias under it as possible (plated shut or plugged and capped).

Target only. 7-bit address 0b0101 0 ADDR1 ADDR0: 0x28 (ADDR1 = GND, ADDR0 = GND), 0x29 (GND, VCC), 0x2A (VCC, GND), 0x2B (VCC, VCC). Every device also answers the broadcast address 0b0111100 (0x3C) whatever the ADDR pins; broadcast reads are valid only if all devices hold the same value. Up to four devices per bus. Auto-increment (Auto_Incr_EN, default 1) writes or reads consecutive registers in one transfer.

fSCL up to 400 kHz, bus capacitance 10-200 pF per line. VIH >= 1.4 V, VIL <= 0.4 V, input current +-1 uA, SDA VOL <= 0.4 V at 5 mA; SDA and SCL 0-5.5 V (6 V absolute maximum) whatever VCC is, so they are compatible with 1.8, 3.3 and 5 V pull-ups. The bus needs pull-ups (1.8-4.7 kOhm typical), normally at the controller.

params.reason: The address is set by straps (ADDR0/ADDR1 must not float); the part has no default. 0x28 is ADDR1 = ADDR0 = GND, the strap the smart-bottle cap board uses. A board strapping another address needs an instance override, which UHD does not have yet.

params.note: VCC 2.7-5.5 V, well regulated: load transients (start-up, fast intensity changes) must not pull it below 2.7 V. 1 uF from VCC to GND close to the device. UVLO: shutdown at VUVF (2 V min, falling), restart at VUVR (2.5 V max, rising), 0.2 V hysteresis; below VUVF the device is held in INITIALIZATION (reset).

Supply current: shutdown (EN = 0) 0.2 uA typ / 1 uA max; standby (EN = 1, Chip_EN = 0) 6 / 10 uA; normal mode 5 / 8 mA with 10 mA per output; automatic power-save (Power_Save_EN = 1, the default, and all LEDs off for longer than tPSM 20-40 ms) 6 / 10 uA. Any I2C command returns the device to NORMAL.

Each RGB LED's cathodes go to three consecutive outputs (OUT3k, OUT3k+1, OUT3k+2), which share the LEDk_BRIGHTNESS register (8-bit, default FFh = 100 %); each output has its own 8-bit OUTx_COLOR register (default 00h). With LEDk_Bank_EN set, the first, second and third outputs follow bank A, B and C colour registers and BANK_BRIGHTNESS instead. Anodes go to the LED supply. §1 describes the three banks as (R, G, B), but §7.3.2 Table 7-1 and the BANK_A/B/C_COLOR registers give no letter-to-colour mapping, so the part assigns none.
32 bottom terminals and the exposed thermal pad are soldered to the board; the package is the mechanical domain's package fact. MSL Level-2, 260 C peak reflow, 1 year floor life.

interfaceGroups.label: Pins that must be connected: VCC (27), GND pad (33), VCAP (32), IREF (31), ADDR0/ADDR1 (25/26), SDA/SCL (28/29)

source: https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/lp5024.pdf (§6.3; §11 package option addendum: LP5024RSMR -40 to 85 C)

params.current_setting: RIREF = 105 x 0.7 V / ISET, one resistor for all channels
params.pwm: 12-bit, 29 kHz typ, per channel; 3-phase PWM shifting; optional dithering
params.color_control: 8-bit OUTx_COLOR per output, 8-bit LEDx_BRIGHTNESS per three outputs, banks A/B/C with BANK_BRIGHTNESS

params.note: After EN goes high (and tEN_H), write DEVICE_CONFIG0 (00h) = 0x40 (Chip_EN = 1) to leave STANDBY. DEVICE_CONFIG1 (01h) resets to 3Ch: Log_Scale_EN, Power_Save_EN, Auto_Incr_EN and PWM_Dithering_EN on, Max_Current_Option = 0 (25.5 mA), LED_Global_Off = 0. Writing FFh to RESET (27h) resets all registers. LEDx_BRIGHTNESS resets to FFh and OUTx_COLOR to 00h, so outputs start dark.

Each output needs its LED's forward voltage plus VSAT (0.25 V typ / 0.35 V max at 20 mA, Max_Current_Option = 0; 0.3 / 0.4 V with option 1) from the LED supply; the output voltage must stay within 0-5.5 V. Power dissipated in the device is the sum of output voltage x current, so a high LED supply heats the package (thermal shutdown at 160 C).

LP5024RSMR: VQFN (RSM) 32, 3000-unit large tape and reel, Active, -40 to 85 C, marking LP 5024. LP5024RSMRG4 is listed separately (NIPDAU finish only). The LP5018 (18 channels) shares this datasheet and pinout except that its RSM pins 19-24 are NC.
